verses.1: A Song of Ascents. Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in his ways.
verses.2: For you will eat the labour of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.
verses.3: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.
verses.4: Behold, this is how the man who fears the LORD is blessed.
verses.5: May the LORD bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
verses.6: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.
